technical_and_design_decisions: Use RESTful API for domain deploy/undeploy/redeploy operations, leveraging existing Mule deployment infrastructure
Extend the existing DeploymentService to support property overrides during app deployment
Define an XSD schema for AMQP transport configuration to enable IDE autocomplete and validation
Use Maven archetype to create a base project skeleton with agreed placeholders for endpoints, connectors, and transactions
Refactor AMQP transport to have a single, reusable configuration class for common transport attributes
Implement continuous AMQP message consumption using a message-driven listener (e.g., with RabbitMQ client)
Implement instant/polling AMQP message consumption using a poll-based message source in Mule
Use existing Mule event model to deliver consumed AMQP messages as MuleEvents to flows
assumptions: The developer is experienced with Mule ESB, Java, and the RabbitMQ client library
All user stories are to be implemented in a single increment
Existing Mule source code and build environment are available
An AMQP broker (RabbitMQ) is available for integration testing
The deployment API will be integrated with Mule's management console or REST API
Effort estimates assume a single developer performing all tasks including design, coding, testing, and documentation
No significant dependencies on other teams or external components
The base project skeleton is for new Mule applications using AMQP transport
The specification review process (U3) involves writing a specification document and setting up a review workflow

activities.activity_description: Design, implement, and test REST endpoints for deploying, undeploying, and redeploying Mule domains, including updating all associated apps.
Enhance the DeploymentService to allow overriding application properties during deployment, including design, coding, and unit testing.
Write a specification document for community review and establish a review workflow to collect feedback.
Create an XSD schema for AMQP transport configuration to enable IDE autocomplete, validation, and error detection.
Create a Maven archetype or template project with agreed placeholders for endpoints, connectors, and transactions for AMQP integrations.
Refactor the AMQP transport to provide a single, reusable configuration mechanism for common transport attributes.
Implement a message-driven listener that continuously consumes AMQP messages from a queue and delivers them as MuleEvents to a flow. Includes unit and integration testing.
Implement a poll-based AMQP message source that allows consuming messages on demand at any point in the flow. Includes unit and integration testing.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across all features, fix defects, and write user documentation for the new capabilities.
